subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support remote http(s) identity avatars, or should remote avatar inputs remain accepted only for non-Control-UI surfaces and be documented/validated as unsupported for Control UI rendering?
rationale: The remaining fix changes CSP, operator-browser network behavior, privacy, local file-serving diagnostics, and the public avatar contract, so automation should not choose the security posture silently.

options.title: Keep local/data-only Control UI avatars
options.body: Preserve the current CSP and update CLI help, docs, validation, and UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

options.title: Add a same-origin remote avatar proxy
options.body: Support remote avatars through a gateway-owned proxy/cache with explicit auth, MIME, size, caching, SSRF/privacy, and failure-feedback rules.

options.title: Allow direct browser remote fetches
options.body: Let the browser load arbitrary remote avatar URLs and accept the weaker image CSP and operator privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep local/data-only Control UI avatars
recommendation.body: Preserve the current CSP and update CLI help, docs, validation, and UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main and merged-PR signal across Control UI CSP, authenticated avatar rendering, docs, and gateway avatar behavior.
